newsitem.title: THAILAND: First Asia, Securities One merger soon.
newsitem.headline: First Asia, Securities One merger soon.

text.p: Thai brokerage First Asia Securities Plc said on Thursday its merger with Securities One Plc is expected to be completed in the first quarter this year.
After the completion of merger, First Asia will seek to delist its shares from the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) within six months, the company said in a filing to the SET.
Securities One and First Asia Securities announced a six billion baht ($240 million) merger deal in April last year in an attempt to become a major regional broker.
Securities One completed its tender offer for First Asia shares late last year.
Under the deal, Securities One issued 27 million new shares to buy all 50 million shares and warrants of First Asia through a share swap.
